		this.name = name;
		this.sailingLevelRequired = sailingLevelRequired;
		this.navigationLocation = navigationLocation;
		this.spriteID = spriteID;
	}

	public static Port getPort(int portId) {
		for (Port p : Port.values()) {
			if (p.id == portId) {

			}
		}

	}

	@Override
	public String toString()
